correctness.rationale: For k>=1 with q=4^k complete atomic four-value assignments and c=2^k classical assignments, an S5 pointed world is semantically determined by (a,S) with nonempty S subset Q and a in S. Structural induction uses subformula value at a and the set of subformula values on S, which the 24 published modal clauses alone inspect. A classical-only S forces classical outputs by induction. Complete finite-table crisp tests delta_t,delta_b,delta_n,delta_f identify local atom vectors; the one-layer formula E_a=L_a or tilde-bullet_t(L_a) detects global occurrence of a; their conjunctions distinguish every (a,S). When any nonclassical atomic value appears, G(Z)=(circ_b Z and Z) or bullet_b Z or tilde-bullet_b Z applied to b/f local flags supplies uniform b and then n. Disjoining characteristic tests realizes every permitted function, not just each Boolean designatedness pattern. Counting N=q*2^(q-1) and Nc=c*2^(c-1) gives 2^(2N-Nc), e.g. k=1 exponent60 and k=2 exponent1048544. One world per support type gives sharp <=q small models, and requiring every type attains q. The script has all k=1 pointed supports and sample k=2 supports, not an infinite proof.
